verdict.rationale: Airwallex explicitly documents scoped API keys that grant only Read/Write permissions on specific APIs instead of full account access, with best-practice guidance and a management flow for creating them, plus AgentOS/OAuth-based Partner Connections tailored for agent access to production accounts. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of scoping granularity and confirmation that AgentOS itself defaults to least-privilege scopes rather than broad access.
